svg.title: Medallion Architecture
svg.desc: Medallion Architecture. Bronze, silver, gold: raw data is refined in layers inside a lakehouse. Step 1, Bronze: land as-is: Bronze: records from all three sources land unchanged, bad ones included, plus load metadata. Step 2, Silver: clean and conform: Silver: a job reads new rows, drops 12 duplicates and conforms codes; 3 go to quarantine, 985 pass. Step 3, Gold: shape for use: Gold: silver is aggregated and modelled into business tables, one for each audience. Step 4, Fix and replay: A currency bug is fixed and replayed from bronze; lineage shows which tables and consumers it hit.

g.text: Bronze: records from all three sources land unchanged, bad ones included, plus load metadata.
Silver: a job reads new rows, drops 12 duplicates and conforms codes; 3 go to quarantine, 985 pass.
Gold: silver is aggregated and modelled into business tables, one for each audience.
A currency bug is fixed and replayed from bronze; lineage shows which tables and consumers it hit.
object storage + open table format (Delta Lake, Iceberg, Hudi)
appended unchanged: nothing fixed, nothing dropped
silver job: reads only new rows, parses and types fields
countries → ISO codes · amounts → USD · joins customers
gold job: aggregates and models silver for each audience
business names · fast to read · access per audience
fixed job replays bronze into silver, then gold
time travel: compare orders v12 (buggy) with v13 (fixed)
